native.note: Tax due by effective financial year, not cash receipts, property values or transaction counts. The inclusive annual total includes transactions whose details are restricted; the other three measures exclude untypical and undisclosed transactions. They overlap and must not be added. No confidential components are inferred. Values are publisher-rounded and may be revised, including for higher-rate refunds. Latest available completed financial year in this dataset; unchanged annual totals are not daily-stale.
